links.outcome: LLM protocol selection accuracy against radiologist consensus reference standard
links.effect: Accuracy up to 0.94 and Jaccard up to 0.96 for the larger models; unacceptable selections ranged from 5.8% to 68.3% depending on model.
links.quote: Unacceptable protocol selections ranged from 70/1201 cases (5.8%) for GPT-OSS and 71/1201 (5.9%) for Qwen3 to 297/1201 (24.7%) for MedGemma and 820/1,201 (68.3%) for Gemma3.

screen.reason: The study retrospectively evaluates the performance and safety/error profile of four open-weight LLMs in selecting MRI protocols from 1,201 clinical referral forms compared to expert radiologist consensus, but it does not test a specific deployment safeguard or intervention.
